notes: Version B (4x/8x cluster highlighted) of Figure 2. Figure 2. (a) ERA5 vs BADM: n=631, Spearman rho=0.578, axis range [1, 658044.6] mm/yr; excludes 150 sites (BADM missing or ==0, or era5_map_mm==0). (b) ERA5 vs BIO12: n=780, Spearman rho=0.592, axis range [1, 658044.6] mm/yr; excludes 1 site (era5_map_mm==0: CA-TP2). (c) BADM vs BIO12: n=632, Spearman rho=0.933, axis range [18, 4500] mm/yr; excludes 149 sites (BADM missing or ==0).
